tool_input.command:
cat > /tmp/boot_alpine.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Create a working directory
mkdir -p /tmp/qemu_work
cd /tmp/qemu_work

# Copy the alpine disk to a writable location
cp /app/alpine-disk.qcow2 ./disk.qcow2

# Start QEMU with the Alpine disk
# Using network forward and serial console for interaction
qemu-system-x86_64 \
  -drive file=disk.qcow2,format=qcow2 \
  -m 512 \
  -nographic \
  -serial mon:stdio \
  -net user,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:2222-:22 \
  -net nic,model=virtio \
  -enable-kvm 2>/dev/null || \
  qemu-system-x86_64 \
    -drive file=disk.qcow2,format=qcow2 \
    -m 512 \
    -nographic \
    -serial mon:stdio \
    -net user,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:2222-:22 \
    -net nic,model=virtio
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/boot_alpine.sh
echo 'Script created'
